protocol.inner_iterations: min(1024, max(1, ceil(8 MiB / file size)))
protocol.strict_win: size <= reference AND encode <=0.90*reference AND decode <=0.90*reference
protocol.source_policy: freeze codec before full corpus performance run; no tuning on holdout results
protocol.scope: User-space page representation, not macOS kernel memory compressor.

datasets.name: zeros.bin
datasets.description: All-zero 1 MiB buffer; excluded from headline performance conclusions.

datasets.name: events_dev.bin
datasets.description: Four interleaved 32-bit fields: timestamp, device ID, signed measurement, status. Synthetic.

datasets.name: events_holdout.bin
datasets.description: New seed, wider device range, occasional full-width signed outliers. Synthetic.

datasets.name: events_shifted.bin
datasets.description: Same held-out records with one-byte prefix: breaks word alignment and lane layout.

datasets.name: random.bin
datasets.description: Uniform pseudo-random bytes; also models already packed uniform 4-bit symbols, not cryptographic RNG.

datasets.name: scattered_palette.bin
datasets.description: 16 scattered byte symbols, not contiguous nibble values. Lossless entropy coding may outperform range packing.

datasets.name: sparse_outliers.bin
datasets.description: Mostly zero 32-bit words with 0.5 percent full-width random outliers. Synthetic.

datasets.name: weather_dev.csv
datasets.description: Unrepeated weather CSV rows, preserving all columns; normalized newline serialization.

datasets.name: weather_dev_i32.bin
datasets.description: Four numerical fields as signed little-endian int32 scaled by10, exact at given precision. Dates and weather labels omitted; NOT a compression of whole CSV. Same binary input for every codec.

datasets.name: weather_holdout.csv
datasets.description: Unrepeated weather CSV rows, preserving all columns; normalized newline serialization.

datasets.name: weather_holdout_i32.bin
datasets.description: Four numerical fields as signed little-endian int32 scaled by10, exact at given precision. Dates and weather labels omitted; NOT a compression of whole CSV. Same binary input for every codec.

datasets.name: rea_cli_public.js
